grid = np.array(grid)
h, w = grid.shape

# Check each column for pattern: [3,3]*n + [0]*m pattern
def analyze_column(col_idx):
    col = grid[:, col_idx]
    # Find where 0s appear
    zero_positions = np.where(col == 0)[0]
    # Check if it forms a contiguous block
    if len(zero_positions) == 0:
        return "all 3s"
    if len(zero_positions) == 1:
        return "one single 0 at row {}".format(zero_positions[0])
    if len(zero_positions) == w - 1:  # all zeros but one
        return "all 0s except one at row {}".format(
            np.where(col == 3)[0][0])
    # Find contiguous blocks of 0s
    blocks = []
    start = zero_positions[0]
    for i in range(1, len(zero_positions)):
        if zero_positions[i] != zero_positions[i-1] + 1:
            blocks.append((start, zero_positions[i-1] + 1))
            start = zero_positions[i]
    blocks.append((start, zero_positions[-1] + 1))
    return blocks[:5]

print("Column analysis (first 10 columns with most 0s):")
zero_counts = np.sum(grid == 0, axis=0)
sorted_by_zeros = np.argsort(zero_counts)[::-1][:10]
for c in sorted_by_zeros:
    desc = analyze_column(c)
    print(f"Col {c} ({zero_counts[c]} zeros): {desc}")
